remarks: Welcome to 21 Seir Hill Road, ideally located in the highly desirable Silvermine neighborhood of Norwalk. Known for its charming, residential feel, Silvermine offers a unique blend of tranquility and convenience-featuring scenic surroundings, close proximity to the Silvermine Golf Club, local art galleries, and easy access to major commuting routes while still maintaining a quiet, neighborhood atmosphere.  This rarely available top-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit is situated in a well-maintained elevator building and is within walking distance to the Merritt 7 train station-perfect for commuters.  The unit features a bright kitchen with ample cabinet space, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, in-unit washer and dryer, a gas fireplace, a jacuzzi tub, and a private balcony with expansive views.  Conveniently located just 2 minutes to the Merritt Parkway, 6 minutes to I-95, and minutes to South Norwalk, offering easy access to dining, shopping, and entertainment.  Assigned parking included. Private garage available for an additional.
